# Static workflows through the actual CLI and daemon, Store, Control and local
# executor. Acceptance captures file authority, so scoped credentials are used.
private-workdir
skygo auth init --data-dir $DATA --auth-file $AUTH --token-output admin.token
skygo auth principal add alice --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add bob --role operator --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth principal add viewer --role reader --auth-file $AUTH
skygo auth token issue alice --auth-file $AUTH --output alice.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue bob --auth-file $AUTH --output bob.token --expires-in 24h
skygo auth token issue viewer --auth-file $AUTH --output viewer.token --expires-in 24h
server start

# Discovery positively reports the workflow service.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json info
stdout 'CAPABILITY_STATIC_WORKFLOWS_V1'

# b and c need a; join needs b and c. Each workload refuses to start before
# the nodes it depends on have finished.
graph-file diamond.tmpl diamond.yaml
graph-file diamond-graph.tmpl diamond-graph.json
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f diamond.yaml --request-id diamond
stderr '^request-id: diamond\n$'
json-field id WF
await-workflow alice.token $WF join succeeded
cp stdout done.json
event-count 4
same-graph diamond-graph.json done.json
json-field nodes.0.job_id AJOB
skygo --token-file alice.token jobs logs $AJOB
stdout '^node a\n$'
skygo --token-file alice.token workflow get $WF
stdout '^'$WF'\tcancel-requested=false\n'
stdout '(?m)^NODE +DISPOSITION +JOB +STATE$'
stdout '(?m)^a +pending +'$AJOB' +succeeded$'
stdout '(?m)^join +pending +[0-9a-f]{32} +succeeded$'
! stderr .

# A listing has summaries, not graphs.
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow list
stdout '"id": *"'$WF'"'
! stdout '"graph"'
skygo --token-file alice.token workflow list
stdout '(?m)^ID +CREATED +CANCEL-REQUESTED$'
stdout '(?m)^'$WF' +\S+ +false$'

# A reader cannot submit, and nothing runs for it.
! skygo --token-file viewer.token workflow run -f diamond.yaml --request-id viewer
stderr 'permission_denied'
calls WorkflowService/SubmitWorkflow 2
calls job-submissions 0
event-count 4

# Another operator cannot see or cancel the workflow; an admin can see it.
! skygo --token-file bob.token workflow get $WF
stderr '^not_found: '
! skygo --token-file bob.token workflow cancel $WF --yes
stderr '^not_found: '
skygo --token-file bob.token --json workflow list
! stdout $WF
skygo --token-file admin.token --json workflow get $WF
stdout '"id": *"'$WF'"'

# A page token belongs to its owner and to workflow listing.
graph-file single.tmpl single.yaml
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow run -f single.yaml --request-id single
json-field id SECOND
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow list --page-size 1
stdout '"id": *"'$WF'"'
! stdout $SECOND
json-field next_page_token PAGE
skygo --token-file alice.token --json workflow list --page-token $PAGE
stdout '"id": *"'$SECOND'"'
! stdout $WF
! skygo --token-file bob.token workflow list --page-token $PAGE
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow list --page-token not-a-cursor
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
skygo --token-file alice.token --json jobs list --page-size 1
json-field next_page_token JOBPAGE
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow list --page-token $JOBPAGE
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow list --page-size 201
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
! skygo --token-file alice.token workflow get not-an-id
stderr '^invalid_argument: '
await-workflow alice.token $SECOND only succeeded
event-count 5
calls job-submissions 0
server stop
! stderr .

-- diamond.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: a
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: a}
- name: b
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: b, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER: a}
  depends_on: [a]
- name: c
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: c, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER: a}
  depends_on: [a]
- name: join
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: join, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER: "b,c"}
  depends_on: [b, c]
-- single.tmpl --
nodes:
- name: only
  task:
    argv: ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"]
    env: {SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD: succeed, SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR: "@DIR@", SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE: only}
-- diamond-graph.tmpl --
{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "name": "a",
      "task": {
        "argv": ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"],
        "env": {"SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD": "succeed", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR": "@DIR@", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE": "a"}
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "b",
      "task": {
        "argv": ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"],
        "env": {"SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD": "succeed", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR": "@DIR@", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE": "b", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER": "a"}
      },
      "depends_on": ["a"]
    },
    {
      "name": "c",
      "task": {
        "argv": ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"],
        "env": {"SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD": "succeed", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR": "@DIR@", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE": "c", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER": "a"}
      },
      "depends_on": ["a"]
    },
    {
      "name": "join",
      "task": {
        "argv": ["@WORKLOAD@", "-test.run=^TestWorkflowWorkload$"],
        "env": {"SKYGO_WORKFLOW_WORKLOAD": "succeed", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_DIR": "@DIR@", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_NODE": "join", "SKYGO_WORKFLOW_AFTER": "b,c"}
      },
      "depends_on": ["b", "c"]
    }
  ]
}
